name: mandatory-current-installed-v1
purpose: Sequential current-wheel mandatory profile observations, starting with Windows PyQt6; no native production.
consumer: One isolated clean installed consumer in registered scratch, using existing CPython and retained core/filtered Qt profile wheels. Install exact hash-locked dependencies and the already assembled current candidate offline in copy mode. No dependency refresh, SDK build, clone, or existing environment mutation.
budget_basis: The prior Windows Qt row used this384MiB budget for its consumer, bounded package cache and scenarios. Reuse the same dependency payload; run rows sequentially under the shared20GiB cap and10GiB reserve. Do not increase this profile silently for other binding closures.
checks: Retain current collector/scenario/source hashes before execution. Use original seven-stage plain QWidget functional scenario: exact installed artifact, binding/device, parent/show/resize, capture/update/image ownership, overlay/hide/restore, injected device-loss recovery and close. Discover, inventory and strict replay; preserve all attempts and allow at most two receipt extensions only for newly observed files. Keep installed/profile/release claims distinct.
guards: Check source/backing/store reserves and shared managed scratch. Continuous child guards tolerate only disappearing test-owned files, enforce declared scratch and wall limits, terminate/wait only owned children, and preserve failures. WSL rows additionally require guest/backing checks and their selected driver/rootfs inputs.
cleanup: Retain actual exits/waits, all reports/traces, source and original licenses plus exact immutable dependency/artifact references outside scratch. Clean producer-owned cache through its supported command; inspect/apply the bounded managed cleanup using registry613 and report results before the next row.
scope: Current mandatory-row observation only. No prior-wheel admission transfer, eight-row admission, final-head CI, protected integration, release or hardware/full-parity claim. Existing frozen preparations and failures remain authoritative.
